---
name: bare-advice
description: Advises on naming a branch for a piece of work. Use when the user asks what to call a branch or whether a branch name is a good example of the house style.
---

# Branch names

1. Read what the work is about from the conversation or the ticket the user named.
2. Name the branch after the change it carries, in lowercase words joined by hyphens,
   with the ticket number in front when there is one.
3. Keep it under forty characters, and drop words that every branch in the repository
   would share.
